#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int w, k;
unordered_set<long long> set;

void solve(int i, long long sum) {
    if (i > k) {
        set.insert(sum);
        return;
    }
    solve(i + 1, sum + (long long)pow((double)w, (double)i));
    solve(i + 1, sum);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long n;
    cin >> w >> n;

    k = 0;
    if (w > 2) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
            k = i;
            if (pow((double)w, (double)i) > 1e9) {
                break;
            }
        }
        solve(0, 0);
    }

    bool bol = false;
    if (w == 2) bol = true;

    for (auto i : set) {
        if (i >= n && set.count(i - n) > 0) {
            bol = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << (bol ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;

    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
